summary.title: Make your own blog
summary.one_liner: A free, interactive beginner course that teaches PHP by building a small database-powered blog with SQLite and PDO, with no framework.
takeaways: Learn to build a simple database-powered blog in PHP, step by step through an interactive course.
See how PHP connects to SQLite using PDO, runs queries, and handles errors.
Understand the author's choice to avoid frameworks so learners see the underlying mechanics.
The course is free, needs no sign-up, and is said to work with PHP 5.5 and later 7.x versions.
summary.summary: This is a free, interactive beginner course on PHP that walks through building a simple blog backed by a database. Each change is shown as a diff, with related file changes grouped into sets such as index.php, install.php, lib/common.php and view-post.php. The code uses SQLite through PDO and deliberately avoids frameworks so learners see the basics first. The FAQ says it works on PHP 5.5 and any 7.x release, is maintained by the author, and points to Reddit, PHPhelp and GitHub for support and bug reports.
